hooks.command: HOOK="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.crosslink/integrations/hooks/pre-web-check.py"; if [ -f "$HOOK" ]; then CROSSLINK_HOOK_PROVIDER=claude __PYTHON_PREFIX__ "$HOOK"; else exit 0; fi

hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root=(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 0}; $hook=Join-Path $root '.crosslink\integrations\hooks\work-check.py'; if(Test-Path $hook){$env:CROSSLINK_HOOK_PROVIDER='claude'; py -3 $hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE}"
